name: Crowded-short funding capitulation squeeze (1h long the cleansed short crowd)
rationale: MECHANISM: when perp funding crosses DOWN through a negative floor, perp SHORTS are crowded and PAYING to stay short (BTC funding <-6% annualized Mar-2025; a 46-day negative streak Apr-2026, longest since post-FTX). The counterparty is an over-crowded short who must eventually cover — a single bid ignites a self-reinforcing squeeze as covers chase price. We buy the INSTANT of the funding cross (a capitulation-in-progress, not a static level), require price to have STOPPED falling (ret_Nd above a knife-guard) so we are not catching a free-fall, and require contained vol so the funding print is not lagging a crash. With funding_feature wired, our open long is not charged carry while funding is negative — the positioning extreme IS the edge (non-economic forced-to-cover flow). DISCONFIRMER: replace the funding cross_down with a funding-LEVEL lt — if the static level does as well, the cross adds nothing and this is a re-skin of funding-reversion (memory: funding-carry HARVEST decayed to ~0 in 2025, so only the cross-EVENT can carry the Sharpe); also drop the open_interest-rising arm — if it does not degrade, the crowding read is cosmetic. Net of fees.
catalyst: funding cross_down into a crowded-short extreme while price stops falling and OI rises
